liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mind Left Body Jam** (1 review): Jerry plays one beat behind the band during this jam section [12]
- **To Lay Me Down** (1 review): This version is considered the best, avoiding drag while inspiring thought [14]
- **The Other One** (1 review): A passage before the Mind Left Body Jam is exceptionally groovy [16]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The transition from China Cat Sunflower to I Know You Rider is lovely [17]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): This performance is cited as one of the best versions heard [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-11-20.144265.sbd.boswell.smith.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 32 songs; 220 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd73-11-20.sbd.hollister.1234.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 31 songs; 200 min; rated 4.79/5 by 19 [4]. Said about its sound: Instruments are clean and clear, with strong bass and no noticeable hiss; Keith's piano is clearly audible, unlike other recordings where guitars drown it out [13][15]
- **gd1973-11-20.sbd-patched.sirmick.76616.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 31 songs; 201 min; rated 5/5 by 7 [5]
- **gd73-11-20.wolfson.warner.22879.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 31 songs; 206 min; rated 4.5/5 by 8 [6]. Said about its sound: The audience recording has bad sound quality, described as muddy and unpleasant; The audience recording sounds surprisingly clear, almost like a soundboard capture [18][19]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls being born on this date, linking the show to their personal history [11]
- This performance highlights the band's development trajectory during the late 1973 period [9]
- The show is overshadowed by performances from November 11 and 17 [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-11-20.144265.sbd.boswell.smith.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Will Boswell; transferred by Matt Smith, Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Soundboard Cassettes > Will Boswell's 1st generation Reels @ 3.75 ips [1]
- **gd73-11-20.sbd.hollister.1234.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Transfer path includes MR, DAT, CD, EAC, and SHN via David Hollister [4]
- **gd1973-11-20.sbd-patched.sirmick.76616.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by SirMick; source: S:MR > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN (shnid 1234) [5]. Also: Patch source used Cary Wolfson's Sony mic and TC-124 recording [5]
- **gd73-11-20.wolfson.warner.22879.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Cary Wolfson; transferred by A > D by David Minches; source: Audience Recording [6]
